messages:
Maya K: Quick sync — we need final partner inputs for the cost model run tomorrow. Specifically: reserved tenor buckets, bid-shape (time-of-day) for spot, eviction probability curves, and any listing/marketplace fees. Can folks paste the fields they will own? :spiral_calendar:

Alex P: I can own the CSV from partners + mapping. Will ask partners for hourly bid shape by region and commit windows. @Chen W do you need per-SKU granularity or is GPU class enough?

Chen W: Per-SKU preferred (e.g., A100-80GB-v2-xyz_sku). Finance needs: base_hourly, reserved_discount_tiers (3), preempt_rate (per hour), median_eviction_length_mins, minimum_commit_slots, billing_granularity (mins). Also: listing_fee_percent and marketplace_tier.

Sylvia R: For on-prem partners we'll provide sample eviction traces. Quick note: spot preempt behavior is not stationary — we see diurnal spikes in evictions (2-5x) during EUR daytime for some pools. Suggest partners provide hourly preempt_prob vectors for 24h.

Maya K: Good call. So schema should include: sku, region, hour_0..hour_23_preempt_prob, reserved_10/30/90_day_discount, min_commit_hours, billing_unit_mins, listing_fee_pct, notes.

Alex P: Putting together CSV template now. Will share link in ~10m. Also asking partners for historical eviction hist (CSV of <timestamp,evicted_count,active_count>) for last 90 days if available.

Chen W: For the cost sim we'll also need SLA uplift multipliers (if partner promises <100ms tail) and avoidance credits for guaranteed capacity. Add field: sla_latency_tier and guaranteed_percent.

Sylvia R: Partner ops note: some vendors only expose commit windows on a weekly cadence (e.g., change effective Monday 00:00 UTC). We need to model the ramp latency — add "commit_effective_delay_hours"

Jordan F: From billing/marketplace side: confirm whether listing fees are taken on the committed rate or on the marketplace surcharged price. Partners differ here. Please capture rule: listing_fee_basis = ["committed_price","marketplace_price"].

vendorbot: VendorZen: new commit slots uploaded for sku A100-80GB-zz in us-west. See https://vendorzen.example/slots/12345 :robot_face:

Maya K: Thanks. Two asks before I close the loop: (1) Alex — drop CSV template and sample filled row; (2) Partners: return at least one 90-day eviction trace or we fallback to default seasonal profile.

Alex P: CSV template posted: https://redwood-share.internal/supply-csv-template. Sample row (one line):

```
sku,region,base_hourly,reserved_10_pct,reserved_30_pct,reserved_90_pct,min_commit_hours,billing_unit_mins,listing_fee_pct,listing_fee_basis,commit_effective_delay_hours,guaranteed_percent,sla_latency_tier,hour_0_preempt_prob,...,hour_23_preempt_prob
A100-80GB-zz,us-west,3.50,0.05,0.12,0.25,720,60,0.03,committed_price,48,0.8,standard,0.01,...,0.02
```

Chen W: That looks good. I'll run a quick sensitivity sweep with three preempt scenarios: low (avg 0.5%/hr), medium (1.5%/hr), high (4%/hr) and share results by EOD.

Sylvia R: I'll annotate known non-stationary windows per vendor (e.g., maintenance windows, region-specific grid events) and add an example trace for one vendor.

Maya K: Perfect. If anyone cannot get partner eviction traces, ping me and I'll escalate to vendor manager. Closing this thread once CSVs are ingested. :white_check_mark:
